adjudication_type: fresh independent focused assessment; standalone answers only
question: How are Factory cards, encounter tokens, and the structure bonus set up, and who starts?

predetermined_key.expected_answer: Shuffle Factory cards; select players+1 face-down and return others unseen to box. Put an encounter token on each of 11 marked territories. Randomly select one face-up structure bonus tile. Lowest numbered Player Mat starts, then clockwise.

grading_rule: correct: every requested material part resolved without contradiction or unsupported guess; partial: requested material omission without contradictory ruling; incorrect: material contradiction

authoritative_source.reason: Extracted source supplies unambiguous relevant setup text with page markers.

passages.wording: Shuffle the Factory cards and randomly select X cards face-down, where X is the number of players plus 1. Place those cards on the board face-down and return the rest of the Factory cards to the box without looking at them.
Randomly select one of the structure bonus tiles and place it face-up at the bottom of the Popularity Track.
Place 1 encounter token on each territory marked with an encounter symbol on the board (11 total tokens).
The player with the lowest number in the label on their Player Mat will go first. Play proceeds clockwise from there.

scope_and_ambiguity_reasoning.factory_randomization_reason: The question asks how Factory cards are set up, rather than only their count or face orientation. Randomizing the available subset is a material part of that procedure in both the predetermined key and the source: it determines which Factory actions enter the game. It is therefore within the requested scope.
scope_and_ambiguity_reasoning.no_required_magic_word: The word shuffle is not mandatory. An explicit random selection of the players-plus-one subset supplies the material randomization result. The remaining Factory cards are not used, and visitors choose among the available cards; specifying random subset selection is sufficient without separately reciting the physical shuffling step.
scope_and_ambiguity_reasoning.face_down_is_not_randomization: Face-down selection and returning unused cards without looking establish concealment, not randomness. One can select a fixed-position subset from an unshuffled deck while complying with that wording. Randomization cannot be supplied by assuming prior game knowledge, the summary wording, or the other reader answer.
scope_and_ambiguity_reasoning.turn_direction: The question asks who starts. Clockwise succession, though included in the key and source, answers how later turns proceed and is not independently requested by this wording. Both readers identify the starting player correctly; neither loses credit for omitting clockwise.
scope_and_ambiguity_reasoning.layout_precision: Both answers supply the selected Factory-card count, face-down state and unseen return of the remainder; B also expressly places them on the board. A does not expressly name the board or box but its selected face-down cards and returned remainder communicate the functional setup. Those conventional destination labels do not create an additional material omission. Both explicitly place the structure tile face-up below the Popularity Track.
scope_and_ambiguity_reasoning.summary_use: The snapshot was read for context only. Its setup includes shuffling/random selection and clockwise play. Its contents do not fill gaps in either standalone answer.
